rows.en:
This is... blood★
I hurriedly looked down and............!

"Eeeeeek☆"
Kazama was there.
...No.
Kazama's corpse was there...
His neck was bent at an unnatural angle, and blood was gushing out of him.
He was completely dead.
Even so, he was still holding me tight.{p}...Kazama's body had cushioned my fall, and that was how I'd survived.
Poor Kazama...
Lucky!

Poor Kazama...
He protected me with his life, and all I ever did was say nasty things to him...
Before I knew it, tears were spilling from my eyes.
He always went at his own pace...
He never took anything seriously...
He was a weird guy, but...
...somehow I just couldn't hate him.
"I should have gone on at least one date with him..."
Crying, I murmured those words.
And then...{p}

Kazama's head, which had been dangling limply, slowly rose, spun all the way around once, and looked at me.
His two eyes, wide open and glaring, gave off a golden light.
"I shall grant that wish."
The words that came from his slack, gaping mouth were heavy and cold, as if echoing up from the depths of the earth.{p}

Then ripples spread across the surface of the floor, and Kazama's corpse began sinking into it, down and down.
"Eek!"
As if Kazama were dragging me in after him, my body sank into the floor too...
The more I struggled, the faster I sank.
Like a bug that had fallen into an antlion's pit...
And Kazama, who had dragged me in, would be the antlion larva, I suppose.{p}

"I'm so happy.
To think I get to go on a date with you, {b}...
From now on, we'll be together forever.
Heh heh heh heh heh..."{p}Deep in my fading consciousness, the antlion was laughing happily...{p}

...No, I'll run after all.
Getting away comes first, no matter what.{p}

"Wait!"
Kazama grabbed my arm.
"Wait.
Are you going to leave me too?
Even though I'm trying this hard to stop you...?"
"Let go of me.
I promised to meet Shindo."
I shook off Kazama's arm and carefully went down the stairs.
"I see!
So you were in love with him after all!"
From the top of the stairs came Kazama's voice, shaking with rage.

When I turned and looked up, Kazama was standing there with a terrifying look on his face.
His whole body was trembling, and his hair, radiating heat, wavered back and forth.
"To think you'd choose him over me...
You're wrong!"
With his eyes fixed on me, Kazama slowly came down the stairs.
He looked like a demon, or a devil...
Under his glare, the strength drained out of my body.
Before I knew it, I had sunk down onto the stairs.{p}

"I'll never hand you over to some other guy.
I'll make you see your mistake myself."
With an evil smile at the corner of his mouth, Kazama slowly reached out with both arms.
His cold arms touched my neck.
"Look, see?
I'm there in your eyes.
And you're there in my eyes, aren't you?
That's because we're lovers who love each other."
His outstretched arms tightened their grip.
It's over...{p}

I closed my eyes.
Because that was the only resistance I could put up...{p}After all, if I'm going to see something in my final moment, I want it to be the smile of the person I love.{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! Right, I don't have time to waste dithering.
Go on a date with Kazama
Just run

"Yes, I want to go on a date with you, Kazama."
...If I call it a date, I can just get him to take me to the school gate.
I'm so smart!
"Is that so, is that so?
You're a sweet girl."
"So, I have a favor to ask..."
"Hm?
What is it? Go ahead, ask me anything."
...Yes! This is what I was waiting for.
"There's a place that's really popular with girls as a date spot right now.
I'd love to go there..."
"Oh...?
And where would that be?"
"The school gate!"
"Huh, the school gate, eh..."
Kazama was grinning.{p}

...Was that a bit too forced?
"I know dates at the school gate used to be all the rage, but they're out of style now."
"...Huh?"
"The place that's about to be in the spotlight as the hot date spot is right here!"
...'Here'? This is a staircase!
I thought a date at the school gate was ridiculous enough, but the stairs......★{p}

"{b}...
Do you know what this place is called?
It's called the landing, the 'odoriba'.
In other words, the place where you dance.
Come on, you've gotta dance, baby."
"Wh-what?"

"C'mon, music!
............Oom-pa-pa-pa, ta-ta-tum.
Tum-tum-ta-tum, hmm-hmm-hm-hmm............"
Humming a dubious tune, Kazama began doing some sloppy dance steps.
He spun around to the right, then to the left, hopping up and down.{p}What part of this is supposed to be a date?
Sneak away while I have the chance
Dance with him
What do I do...

"............Oom-pa-pa-pa, ta-ta-tum.
Tum-tum-ta-tum, hmm-hmm-hm-hmm............"
No way, dancing is actually pretty fun!
How should I put it... it's this unique rhythm.
It's getting me all bouncy and excited.{p}

"Oh, that's my {b}.
You've got a pretty good sense of rhythm.
Alright, let's pick up the tempo even more!
...Boom-ta, boom-ta, bom-bom-bom.
Trot-trot, trot-trot...
...La-la-la, la-la-la-la............
There, take a look.
All sorts of things have gathered, drawn in by your dancing."
"What...?"
At Kazama's urging, I looked around.{p}

...And all around us, packed in tight, all sorts of people had gathered.
Every one of them had a pale, lifeless face...
Even so, they were dancing desperately.
Eyes glittering, teeth clenched, they kept on stepping.
...What on earth is wrong with all of you?
Is dancing like that any fun?{p}

Oh, they're all wearing red shoes.
Men and women alike...
All of them were dancing in matching bright red shoes.
But those were...{p}

They weren't wearing red shoes. Blood was streaming from their feet!
They'd all been dancing with blood flowing from their feet★
Among the dancers, dancing as if possessed, I spotted Shindo.
Iwashita was there too.
And... Fukuzawa, and Hosoda too...
The one in the far corner over there was Arai...
On their feet too, I could see bright red shoes.{p}

"Now, these are your shoes."
The devil with Kazama's face pointed at my feet, looking as if he were enjoying this more than he could stand.{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! I can't just keep dithering.
Tell him I want to go on a date
Tell him I don't want to go on a date

"We are NOT lovers!
Put me down right now.
I'm going home by myself!"
I shook off Kazama's arms and stood on the floor of the landing on my own two feet.{p}

Lucky!
Aren't I just the luckiest?
It might have been a disaster for Kazama, but he brought the accident on himself.
It's not my fault.{p}

I'll sneak away while I have the chance.
I tiptoed, ever so quietly, to the edge of the stairs.{p}

"Huh? {b}, where are you going?"
...Oh no!
He spotted me.{p}Hmm, how should I answer him?
I'm getting out of here
Just... to the restroom
I'm not going anywhere

"What do you mean, where...
I'm getting out of here, that's where."{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! This is no time to dither.
Sneak away while I have the chance
Dance with him

"Um, well...
I'm just, uh... going to the restroom............"
...He can totally see through that, can't he?
But that was the only excuse I could come up with on the spot.
"Oh, I see.
Well then, be careful."{p}

With that, Kazama went off down the stairs, still dancing.
............Somehow he really throws me off.
Oh well...
I need to get out of this place quickly too!{p}

...And then, somehow, I really did need to go to the restroom.
Restroom... restroom............
I hurried to the restroom.
And then...{p}

"Hey, {a}.
You need the restroom too?"
Suddenly, Hosoda appeared right in front of me.
He was standing in the narrow entrance as if to block my way.
...He's in the way. I wish he'd move.
"Restrooms are nice, aren't they?
Me... I feel more at ease in a cramped restroom than in any luxurious room."
And anyway, what is this guy doing in front of the girls' restroom?
Could he be some kind of pervert...?
"Um, Hosoda...
This is... the girls' restroom, isn't it?"{p}

"That's right.
You see, I figured that if I waited in the girls' restroom, I'd be sure to meet you.
But you just weren't coming, so I was about to give up.
But I'm glad... that you came."
Hosoda forcibly took my hand and shook it.
And then,
"Well then, {a}, get home safe.
Hee hee hee hee..."{p}

...he said, and with a wave he went off down the dim hallway.
Kazama's weird, but Hosoda's a pretty strange one too...
Where on earth did Hino ever meet people like them?
Around the time Hosoda's back disappeared from view...
I noticed something strange clutched in my hand.{p}

...What is it?
I slowly opened my hand.{p}

"Eek...☆"
What was clutched in my hand was a knife smeared with blood.
When did this get here...★
Ah, it was when we shook hands just now.
That handshake was to make me hold this knife...☆
Then where did this blood come from...?
Fearfully, I peered into the restroom.{p}

A thick, nose-stinging stench made me shut my eyes without thinking.
It wasn't just the usual restroom smell.
It was more like the smell of iron, and yet somehow raw and fishy...
What on earth was that smell...?{p}

The moment I opened my eyes, wondering that, my gaze was nailed to the floor.
"Ah... ahh..."
I was so shocked I couldn't even scream.
Iwashita was lying face up on the floor.
Her throat had been slit straight across, and the blood that had flowed from it had dyed everything around her bright red.
...Did Hosoda do this?
Looking back and forth between the knife forced into my hand and Iwashita's corpse, I was certain of it.

"I'm not going anywhere in particular."
"No?
Then let's dance together."
...Oh well, I guess I'll humor him and dance a little.{p}

While I was still hesitating, everything before my eyes suddenly went dark.
Before I knew it, darkness had closed in all around me.
Where am I?
Where's Kazama...?{p}

What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...
What do I do...{p}
............Oh! This is no time to dither.
Open my eyes
Keep my eyes closed
